Frontend Playwright (cluster-internal fetch auth path): /redeem page renders with copper KeyRound icon + redeem-input + redeem-submit; footer-redeem-link visible on /redeem AND /scripts; /login toggle navigates to /redeem; /login?redeem=TEST-Z1 deep-link shows login-pending-redeem + 'Sign in to redeem.' title + 'Sign in & redeem' CTA; ProfileMenu replaces flat header (old logout-btn + header-email testids confirmed GONE); profile-menu opens with profile-menu-redeem + profile-menu-signout, NO profile-menu-upgrade for owner (correct dev_bypass); click-outside dismisses menu; body[data-founder='true'] flips nav-link.is-active color to rgb(245, 217, 182) = #F5D9B6 (copper accent verified); Admin Licenses tab present + clickable, licenses-table + licenses-create-btn + licenses-create-panel + licenses-csv-input + licenses-status-filter + licenses-tier-filter + licenses-search all render; zero console errors across /scripts → /admin → /redeem nav.
critical_code_review_comments: licenses_routes.py (~545 LOC) — clean self-contained module; atomic find_one_and_update on {_id, status:'available'} prevents redeem race; downgrade-no-rank-bump path still burns code (correct); protected-user check uses union of DEV_BYPASS_EMAIL + STUDIO_GRANT_EMAILS + founders flag (matches spec).

REDEEMABLE_TIER_IDS frozenset excludes 'founder' — bulk-create test_admin_bulk_create_invalid_tier confirms founder codes are rejected with reason='tier'. Defense-in-depth: the redeem path ALSO double-checks and voids any code with non-redeemable tier that somehow slipped in.
tier_config.py TIER_T1.label='Starter', T2='Creator', T3='Pro', T4='Pro Plus', FOUNDER='Founder' — verified via parametrized /me/quota test across all 4 seeded buyers.

/me/upgrade-target — campaign-window logic via APPSUMO_CAMPAIGN_END_AT (accepts date-only or full ISO, treats as end-of-day UTC, defaults to FALSE on malformed input → safe hide). With all 3 env vars blank, returns {visible:false, reason:'no_url_configured'} as expected.
Auth gating: redeem requires JWT (returns 401/403 unauthenticated); /api/admin/licenses/* all gated by require_admin dep — non-admin (directkynections@gmail.com) properly receives 401/403.

Frontend ProfileMenu — body[data-founder] flag is properly toggled on mount/unmount via the founder-badge component. CSS copper accent (#F5D9B6 / #C9956C) is correctly applied to .nav-link.is-active under body[data-founder='true'].
Old logout-btn and header-email data-testids are confirmed REMOVED — clean migration to ProfileMenu.
Footer redemption link is globally rendered (present on both /redeem and /scripts pages).
Login deep-link replay /login?redeem=CODE correctly stamps the pending-redeem chip and swaps title/CTA copy; clean useSearchParams + localStorage f48_pending_redeem flow.
